acceptance_criteria: Analyze 3 consecutive failed velocity cap attempts and document remediation

deliverables.incident_log: Analyzed 3 consecutive failed velocity cap events: (1) INC-881 at 14:02: Agent attempted $75 payout with $150 already reserved against a $200 hourly velocity cap (HTTP 429 VELOCITY_CAP); (2) INC-882 at 14:05: Immediate retry attempted $75 while remaining hourly velocity budget was only $50 (HTTP 429 VELOCITY_CAP); (3) INC-883 at 14:08: Third attempt of $75 rejected, circuit breaker recorded hold and maintained atomic reservations.
deliverables.remediation_plan: Remediation plan implemented: Split automated payouts into amounts <= remaining velocity budget across successive hourly windows, implemented exponential backoff on agent client, and alerted operator to review agent spend ceiling.
